description_en: Retrieves a list of security optimization suggestions
description_zh: 获取安全优化建议列表
kebab_example: aliyun riskmanagement get-security-suggestion-list --list-config-rule-srequest CompliancePackId=cp-d7b061dbe91500aa179a ResourceTypes=ACS::ECS::Instance Keyword=ecs PageSize=10 ComplianceType=COMPLIANT PageNumber=3 ConfigRuleName=The_name_of_the_rule. RiskLevel=1 ConfigRuleState=ACTIVE --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSecuritySuggestionList

fields.help_en:
The compliance evaluation result. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Insufficient data.
IGNORED: Ignored
fields.help_zh:
合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据。
IGNORED：已忽略
fields.name: compliance_type

fields.help_en:
The rule running status. Valid values:
ACTIVE: Active.
DELETING: Being deleted.
EVALUATING: Being evaluated.
INACTIVE: Inactive
fields.help_zh:
规则运行状态。
ACTIVE：应用中。
DELETING：删除中。
EVALUATING：评估中。
INACTIVE：已停用
fields.name: config_rule_state

fields.help_en:
The query keyword.

Supports fuzzy match on the rule ID, rule name, rule description, and rule template identifier
fields.help_zh:
查询关键字。

支持对规则 ID、规则名称、规则描述和规则模板标识等进行模糊查询
fields.name: keyword

fields.help_en:
The page number.

Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1
fields.name: page_number

fields.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

取值范围：1~100。起始值：1。默认值：10
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en:
The risk level of the rule. Valid values:

1: High risk.
2: Medium risk.
3: Low risk
fields.help_zh:
规则风险等级。取值：

1：高风险。
2：中风险。
3：低风险
fields.name: risk_level

fields.help_en: The resource type evaluated by the rule
fields.name: resource_types
